entries.name: Squarrel
entries.description: Squarrel has a large, fist-shaped tail. When its greasy tail fur is rubbed even slightly, it can burst into flames. Anyone who eyes its stockpiled pinecones will get a taste of its scorching fire fists.

traits.name: Raging Fire
traits.description: After using a skill, the next basic attack used within 10s will directly release the final hit of the basic attack, and its Might is increased from 4 to 25.

skills.name: Pinecone Bomb
skills.description: Throws a flaming pinecone that bursts on impact, scattering an additional 3 pinecone fragments in all directions. Targets hit are marked with Pinecone.

skills.name: Heavy Tail Strike
skills.description: Throws a punch forward. If the target hit has a Pinecone Mark, consumes the Mark to deal 50% more damage, launch the target, and stuns it for Stun2.5s.

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: (BREAK) Wields the power of fire to attack targets at close range.

entries.name: Irisalis
entries.description: They absorb the world’s colors as floral raiment, bringing colorful vitality to nature. If petals wither, they can bloom again by returning to the earth’s embrace.

traits.name: Bloom Cluster
traits.description: When casting Whirling Blossom Rain or landing the final hit of a basic attack, all Irisalis clones fire floral beams at the target, each with 15 Might. If an Irisalis clone’s attack hits, this Aniimo gains 1 Dance Power. After accumulating 9 Dance Power, the next skill cast costs 50% less EP. When Fainted, it turns back into a flower and blooms again, restoring vitality. Can trigger once every 180s.

skills.name: Whirling Blossom Rain
skills.description: Spins and dashes in the chosen direction, firing multiple homing bolts in succession. Also activates all Iris clones to fire floral light beams.

skills.name: Irisalis Shadow
skills.description: After Iris Shot hits a target, summons 1 Iris Clone for 30s. The clone immediately fires a Floral Gleam Beam at the target. Casting the skill again resets the clones.

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: Wields the power of grass to attack targets from a distance.

skills.name: Florae Descent
skills.description: Condenses energy into a massive phantom that dives down and slams into the ground, dealing area damage and leaving 1 Irisalis clone that lasts 30s. This clone can coexist with the clone summoned by Irisalis Shadow. Recasting the Ultimate resets the clone.

entries.name: Sparkelf
entries.description: Sparkelves from the SylphIsle can draw energy from interactions with humans and Aniimo. The livelier and more joyful the gathering, the more energized they become.

traits.name: Reliable Fire Companion
traits.description: When in a party, increases party 15%–18% Fire Elemental Boost. When Energy is above 40, the effect increases to 20%–24%. Gains 0.38% per 100 ATK. Gains 0.50% per 100 ATK.

skills.name: Inspiration
skills.description: Ignites flames to inspire the whole team, increasing Fire Elemental Boost by 12%. At the end, restores 10% of Energy consumed during the effect (up to 10 points), lasting 12s.

skills.name: Treat Feed
skills.description: Pulls out food to heal the team for 8% of the Sparkelf’s HP. If the unit’s HP is below 50%/25%, instead heals them for 12%/16% of the Sparkelf’s HP.

skills.name: Spark Energy
skills.description: Hurls an empowered fireball that explodes on impact, dealing area damage and inflicting 2 stacks of Fire Debuff.

skills.name: Leaping Sparks
skills.description: Throw an empowered fireball that explodes on hit, dealing area Damage and causing the target to take an additional 100% Damage while Shielded for 20 seconds

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: Wields the power of fire to attack targets from a distance.

skills.name: Keep the Fire Bolt Going!
skills.description: Passion Heats Up, dealing AoE Damage and increasing nearby allied units' Fire Elemental Boost by 25% for 30 seconds

entries.name: Lunara
entries.description: Their eyes shimmer with the deep blue light of the moon, and mysterious patterns appear when they wield their power.

traits.name: Lunar Power
traits.description: When not attacking with an advantageous element, final damage increases by 30%. Casting a skill or Ultimate grants 4 stacks of [Silver Moon Mark]. Each basic attack hit consumes 1 stack, deals 100% extra damage, and restores 0.5% HP.

skills.name: Moon Impact
skills.description: Drops a full moon onto the target, triggering an explosion and dealing damage. If it hits a target with Fox Mark, deals additional small-area damage around the target equal to 10%.

skills.name: Lumin Bolts
skills.description: Fires 3 Light missiles at targets, prioritizing different targets. Applies Fox Mark to targets hit, reducing their Light Resistance by 5%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10s.

skills.name: Lunar Eclipse
skills.description: Pours the power of moonlight onto the target, dealing massive additional BREAK damage based on the Aniimo’s level.

skills.name: Moon-Washed
skills.description: Bathes in moonlight and recovers 20 EP.

skills.name: ATK
skills.description: Wields the power of light to attack targets from a distance.

skills.name: Selene's Judgment
skills.description: Unleashes Selene’s Judgment on nearby targets, dealing massive damage, evolves into Fennelun, and increases its Damage Amp by 15% until combat ends. Also gains 4 stacks of Silvermoon Mark.
